column4: Arbitrary two Bessel generators must be completed by exactly one partner each. Abstract dual-frame completion does not preserve the wavelet orbit or single-generator count; no finite certificate or all-generator factorization supplied.
All positive areas require a global confined Willmore variational profile. Round spheres only give the small-area range and cannot settle the large-area obstacle regime; no full-scope route.

The minimized inertia/decomposition groups and commuting-liftability need source definitions; all fields, n including infinity, and explicit finite N form a substantial valuation-theoretic chain. The row reads as an asserted equivalence, not evidence of an unresolved target.
Compute every genus-two CM curve for arbitrary quartic CM field and characteristic-zero base. One class-polynomial example is not the classification over k up to twists; no short uniform mechanism.

The structural stochastic mixture and estimation regime require exact observation/asymptotic assumptions. A rate claim for arbitrary activity mixture needs semimartingale limit theory, not a finite sample certificate.
Odd k and coprime a,q require sharp uniform growth of a weighted exponential sum. Pairing r and q-r leaves oscillatory sine contributions; prime or fixed-k samples cannot determine the full order.

The row omits domain and initial-data regularity. Even after restoration, arbitrary unequal diffusion and all dimensions above two require global a priori PDE estimates; equal-diffusion reduction is only a special case.

The actual Haxell report pp61-62 defines the identical fixed-outer-face linear morph task and explicitly describes an O(n) reduction to weighted Schnyder drawings followed by O(n^2) morphs; it also cites the SODA2013 solution. This is prior solution evidence, not an independently audited algorithm.

High-probability equality for G(n,1/2) needs a sharp lower bound on all biclique partitions matching the induced biclique upper construction. Finite random graphs or rank lower bounds alone do not establish the asymptotic equality.

Minimal hypotheses for arbitrary representation and subgroup families are a classification request. Constant representations give failures, not a resolution of the requested sufficient/minimal conditions; no bounded full-scope route.

Subgroups must define connected finite etale covers, requiring the source's openness/index conventions. Genus divergence for arbitrary families is broad; Riemann-Hurwitz alone does not force growing genus.
The specified Fricke ideal J is not defined in the row. All graded degrees k and ranks n require the exact ideal and its relations; a low-degree derivation cannot settle the whole image.
All partitions and all dimensions require minimal equivariant free resolutions, including higher syzygies. The principal/minor examples do not give a general resolution or prevent cancellation.

Primary Chapuy report pp646-648 states the exact refined recurrence and explicitly distinguishes its KP derivation from the desired bijection. Numerical recursion verification or the one-face Harer-Zagier case does not supply a general bijective map.

Primary Stanley report pp696-697 reproduces Conjecture2 and says both conjectures are proved, then outlines maximum antichains and join-irreducibles of a distributive lattice. Exact displayed formula already has public source proof evidence; full lattice proof not replayed here.

The row is a reported stability result with unspecified smallness, norms, generic frequency exclusions and N conditions. No new statement is extracted from this prose; stability dependency audit would be substantial.

Primary Woerdeman report p1013 states that the two-variable problem was solved in 2004, gives a related rank condition and Christoffel-Darboux identity. Arbitrary negative c_0 trivially blocks existence; that is data admissibility, not new credit.

Sufficient regularity and diffusion/Brownian filtration conventions are not quantified. Reading the two Y equations with the same Brownian motion creates an immediate drift ambiguity; correcting it is not a discovery. No full bridge construction for arbitrary a,sigma.

Primary Bell report p1369 defines all three properties and reports rational-but-not-locally-closed ideals in every Krull dimension at least four, with equivalence in dimension at most three. This directly defeats the general equivalence; construction body and model-theoretic dependencies not replayed.
Arbitrary positive warping functions with bounded curvature require full Ricci-flow behavior, not merely a constant-warp stationary example or short-time existence. No uniform classification route.

The coefficient category, specialization and monodromy maps require source conventions. Classifying precisely all isocrystals giving exactness is not reduced to a small linear algebra computation by the row.

Regularity at finite x and admissible/projective Vogel parameters need exact source domain conventions. Solving the displayed reciprocal Diophantine family alone does not classify all cancellations of the three sinh quotients.

The random-transposition entropic transport metric and normalization matter to an asymptotic sharp curvature bound. The two reported orders differ by n; a small-n Hessian or spectral-gap comparison is not a full uniform bridge.

Universal first-singularity shape, or a rigorously constructed square-root singularity, requires a nonlocal blow-up mechanism. Symmetric stationary/zero data only exposes implicit blow-up assumptions; it earns no domain-correction credit.
Supercyclidic nets, tangent congruences and admissible spline data need source compatibility definitions. The row itself says uniqueness is established; no new solution is proposed from this report.

The conservation law and invertibility of entropy variables need the report. Integrating the physical flux along a straight entropy-variable path is the classical mechanism when admissible; the row explicitly reports a flux family, so no credit or new hypothesis.

The triangular algebra needs the bimodule action and the grading/bracket conventions. A long exact sequence of vector spaces alone does not determine the Gerstenhaber Lie bracket; no small full-graded presentation supplied.

Null smoothness classes, observation law and tuning conditions are missing. The row already reports the minimax rate; proving the displayed testing limit requires both lower and upper bounds, not a threshold calculation.

Best universal Lieb-Oxford constant across all particle numbers and symmetric laws is an infinite-dimensional sharp inequality. Trial densities give one-sided bounds, not the optimum; no short exact extremizer route.

Every T>0 includes the saturated constrained equilibrium regime above pi^2. The semicircle only handles the unsaturated part; a full answer needs the constrained potential and elliptic-integral analysis, with prior-art review.

All hyperelliptic curves over local fields of odd residual characteristic require inertia and Galois action beyond scalar distances alone. A cluster example or tame reduction case is insufficient; known cluster-picture machinery would need a precise full bridge and prior clearance.

Precise exponent for all d<6 and admissible offspring/steps requires critical branching resistance estimates. Series/parallel finite-tree computations cannot determine the conditioned infinite-trace exponent.

Arbitrary probability-preserving transformations give an unrestricted conjugacy classification task. Matching elementary invariants or finite partitions does not decide isomorphism of the measure algebras with dynamics.

The row explicitly states a genus/terminal-parameter running-time algorithm. Exhaustive finite cuts can solve each instance but are not the reported complexity theorem or a new full-scope contribution.
The row asserts fixed-k,fixed-n polynomial-time computability. A residue enumeration is not a polynomial bit-complexity proof for the general fixed dimension, and routine n=2 cases earn no credit.

Interface/domain regularity, finite element spaces, geometry approximations and the norm of second-order accuracy are unspecified. A time stencil without a transport/comparison operator across spaces does not resolve the task.

The construction and hyper-Kahler matching require building-block and marking hypotheses. A single matched pair is a parameter example, not a general solution; the displayed projection condition is a framework rather than a proof.

Finding interesting exceptional triples is an open-ended research program, not a fixed all-triples theorem. Elementary dimension counts or accepted unexpected-curve families cannot create substantive new credit.

Arbitrary fixed point configurations and general fat points encompass difficult interpolation classifications. Row400121 overlaps this program; a single unexpected curve is not a new full-scope outcome.

The monomial ideal and chosen-generator construction are only referred to, and TeX/control characters are corrupted. Different presentations may affect t; no proposed counterexample without the actual arrangement construction.

The row already reports impossibility except ultra-sparse adaptation. Design/noise and honesty classes are not specified; a two-point heuristic cannot replace the full testing lower bound or novelty audit.

Noise and identifiability/separation conventions are missing. Permuting sources yields a trivial label ambiguity; the report says necessary/sufficient criteria and SESAME methodology are obtained. No new claim.

Probability level, initialization, sampling/dependence and lambda scaling must be fixed before an error bound is meaningful. A basic inequality alone leaves restricted curvature and dependent Poisson concentration unresolved.
The record explicitly names Andre's theorem and asserts the equality for the minimal B. Constant trace or torsion cases are special instances; no new all-abelian-variety proof or discovery proposed.
The uniformization map, universal vectorial extension and bi-algebraic structure need exact definitions. Dimension bookkeeping does not supply Ax-Schanuel for every irreducible analytic subvariety.

The interval endpoint is corrupted and k is split by a newline; the intended Poisson multigraph model needs the original. Convergence of successive disjoint spanning-tree costs is not determined by first-tree constants.

Executed exact N=2 Hankel determinant obstruction at epsilon=1/1000: f_k=(1/2)^k+(1/3)^k cannot be approximated by one exponential at that tolerance. This rejects unrestricted strict shortening only; primary pp1890-1893 supplies AAK machinery/algorithm with singular-value thresholds. Wording/domain correction, zero credit.

Same N=2 exact obstruction as400382; more samples cannot eliminate a positive approximation-error floor. Primary pp1890-1893 treats the same task. Corrupted TeX and unrestricted epsilon do not create an independent discovery or second family.

The row claims a complete characterization, but transfer-function and refinement normalizations need the source. Scalar filter instances or invoking UEP alone cannot classify all rectangular multiwavelet masks.

The disorder law, Hamiltonian class and meaning of moderate growth are absent. An arbitrary Hamiltonian cannot be treated as a localized spin system without hypotheses; no domain-based counterexample credited.
